fix2_synthetic_did.status: NOT FEASIBLE with available data (documented, not skipped).
fix2_synthetic_did.reason: Synthetic DiD requires donor units with a single-bidding time series on the SAME (bidder-count) definition as TED, flat over the EU treatment window. No non-EU source provides this: US FPDS = single-OFFER, sector-level, FY2023 cross-section only (no time series); CanadaBuys = non-competitive METHOD proxy (annual, not bidder counts); ProZorro = method proxy 2018-2021 (bid counts not in public API); Brazil/Korea/Mexico/OpenTender not acquired. Mixing method-proxy donors with the bidder-count treated series violates donor commensurability, which the plan itself flags as fatal.
fix2_synthetic_did.moot_note: Fix 2 exists to anchor the EU competition effect on genuine non-adopters; since the EU effect is itself a noisy null (Fix 1), the anchoring purpose is moot.
fix2_synthetic_did.closest_available: The CanadaBuys non-competitive-method proxy comparison (already in the paper, -4.8pp) is the closest external check; it is descriptive, not a Synthetic DiD.
